assumptions.text: The 405 response for non-GET methods on /health has the JSON body {"error":"method not allowed"} and also includes Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
Content-Type is sent as 'application/json; charset=utf-8', which starts with application/json as M01-AC1 requires.
The OpenAPI schema for /health sets additionalProperties: false and includes an example, so it matches exactly {"status":"ok"}.
The unit tests use the global fetch, which needs Node >=18 (package.json declares it in engines).
